record.paper_title: Some Open Problems in Dynamical Systems
record.original_question: Can the characteristic flow on a smooth compact connected hypersurface M^{2n−1} ⊂ R^{2n} be an Anosov flow?

evidence.quote: Can the characteristic flow on M2n−1 be an Anosov flow ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M^{2n-1} \subset \mathbb{R}^{2n}$ be a smooth, compact, connected hypersurface (with $n \geq 2$). Equip $\mathbb{R}^{2n}$ with the standard symplectic form $\omega = \sum_{i=1}^{n} dx_i \wedge dy_i$. The characteristic line field on $M$ is the kernel of $\omega|_{TM}$; its integral curves, after a choice of nonvanishing section (e.g., the Hamiltonian/Reeb-type vector field defining $M$ as a regular level set), define the characteristic flow on $M$.

Recall that a smooth flow $\phi_t$ on a closed manifold $N$ is called Anosov if there exists a continuous $D\phi_t$-invariant splitting $TN = E^s \oplus E^0 \oplus E^u$, where $E^0$ is the line spanned by the flow direction, and there are constants $C > 0$, $\lambda > 0$ such that $\|D\phi_t v\| \leq C e^{-\lambda t}\|v\|$ for $v \in E^s$, $t \geq 0$, and $\|D\phi_{-t} v\| \leq C e^{-\lambda t}\|v\|$ for $v \in E^u$, $t \geq 0$.

Question: Can the characteristic flow on a smooth compact connected hypersurface $M^{2n-1} \subset \mathbb{R}^{2n}$ ever be an Anosov flow?
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches reveal active related research on Anosov characteristic foliations and rigidity of Anosov optical hypersurfaces (e.g., Dairbekov–Paternain), as well as recent constructions of C²-robustly transitive characteristic foliations on hypersurfaces in standard contact (2n+1)-space. However, no source clearly resolves whether a smooth compact connected hypersurface in ℝ^{2n} can carry a globally Anosov characteristic flow, so the status appears unresolved in the literature consulted.

status_evidence.title: Rigidity properties of Anosov optical hypersurfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies rigidity when characteristic foliation is Anosov, but in cotangent bundle setting rather than R^{2n}.
status_evidence.claim: Anosov characteristic foliations are studied in related contexts but the Euclidean R^{2n} hypersurface case is not resolved here.

status_evidence.title: Robustly Non-Convex Hypersurfaces In Contact Manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Constructions of hypersurfaces with robustly transitive characteristic foliations in contact (2n+1)-manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work explores dynamical complexity of characteristic foliations but does not settle the Anosov question for hypersurfaces in R^{2n}.
